properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms have become more concentrated near the  center of a low pressure system located several hundred miles  southwest of the western Azores since yesterday. A short-lived  tropical depression or tropical storm is expected to form later  today or tonight while moving north-northeastward at about 5 mph,  but remaining well to the southwest of the Azores. Upper-level winds  are forecast to become less conducive for development beginning  late Sunday. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

Recent satellite-derived wind data show that the area of low  pressure located well south-southwest of the southwestern coast of  Mexico is still elongated, and the shower and thunderstorm activity  remains disorganized. However, environmental conditions are  conducive for development, and a tropical depression is expected to  form over the next couple of days as the system moves generally  northward off the coast of southwestern Mexico. Interests along the  southwestern and west-central coast of Mexico should monitor the  progress of this system. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

Disorganized showers and thunderstorms continue to persist in  association with an area of low pressure located well southwest of  the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula. Environmental  conditions are conducive for development, and a tropical depression  is expected to form over the next several days as it moves westward  to west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph across the western East  Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD 15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of Tropical  Depression Fifteen-E, located well east of the Hawaiian Islands,  remain disorganized. Environmental conditions appear conducive for  some development of this system next week as it moves westward to  west-southwestward, and a tropical depression could form well to the  south or southeast of the Hawaiian Islands towards the middle to  latter portion of next week. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.
